reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and preserves Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment, matching the preferred position ('no non-solicit on Customer').
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed — the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are heuristics keyed to an existing non-solicit covenant; with no such covenant binding Customer they are inapplicable and do not undercut the finding.

Rationale documents an adequate search (solicit/induce/recruit/hire/employ and review of the Customer Responsibilities, Confidentiality and General sections), so the absence conclusion is reasonably supported rather than asserted.
